section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study that examined gratitude and forgiveness in the same sample, utilizing both self and confidant reports. The research aimed to understand how these character strengths relate to personality factors, emotional vulnerabilities, and positive psychological processes. Findings suggest that gratitude and forgiveness uniquely relate to these factors, with forgiveness showing stronger and more robust relations, often diminishing correlations between gratitude and other variables. Confidant data also indicated that these strengths are observable by others and linked to observer perceptions of well-being.
